summary: The feature is mostly implemented and the suite is green, but the FR-004 stall cap cannot trigger in a real worktree run, and two lower-severity divergences and two minor ones remain. One commit's Red line names no test.

findings.summary: FR-004 stall cap never halts a real run: every issue record gets a different `commit`, so `consecutive_no_commit` stays at 1.
findings.evidence: FR-004. stall_rule (commands.py:725) counts trailing marked records sharing one commit. cmd_issue_add (801) and overrun_issue (917) default commit to worktree_head; each writer commits, moving HEAD. Sandbox probe: three issue-add retry --partial-return without --commit -> consecutive_no_commit 1, halt false; three ledger-add --overrun --partial-return stored 177d7df, cd527a5, c20ec5f. SKILL.md never passes --commit. Only reaching test hard-codes --commit aaa0001. ENG-1.
findings.fix: Record the last work commit (most recent non-`factory:` commit). Add a test: three marked issues without --commit -> halt true.

findings.summary: `verify --fail` lists every command with a truthy status as failing, so string 'pass' statuses are listed as failing.
findings.evidence: FR-010. failing = [c for c, st in commands_payload if st]; repo verify statuses use string "pass". Test uses only int 0/1.
findings.fix: Passing = 0 or 'pass'; test with string statuses.

findings.summary: FR-007 (record orchestrator verify overrun) has no executable instruction or mechanism.
findings.evidence: SKILL.md gives no command, no timing method, no --cause; issue-add overrun refuses missing cause.
findings.fix: State exact command `factory issue-add overrun <stage> orchestrator --cause tool-slow --detail ... --duration-ms <n>` and how verify time is measured against `factory budget orchestrator`.

findings.summary: `factory improvements` lists claimed backlogs too; FR-012 says ready backlogs.
findings.evidence: list_backlogs globs every *.json; SKILL.md says show each ready backlog.
findings.fix: Filter to ready, or amend FR-012/SKILL.md; test it.

findings.summary: Export runs on every set-status pr-open|aborted; repeat call rewrites claimed backlog to ready.
findings.evidence: Spec: export written once at run end. export os.replace unconditionally.
findings.fix: Leave existing backlog untouched; test claimed survives second set-status.

findings.summary: T026's `Red:` line names a shell command, not a mapped test.
findings.evidence: Commit eb337fb: 'Red: tools/bench.py run --harness codex (expected named refusal with exit 1)'. No test covers run refusal.
findings.fix: Add test for unsupported-harness refusal or name an existing test.
